compliance.summary: The page presents GoGloby as an Applied AI engineering and global-expansion provider rather than a staffing and recruiting agency, and promotes an unapproved Benchmark briefing. It also contains unsupported timing, office, contact, client, media, and certification claims.

llm_problems.title: Applied AI services positioning
llm_problems.issue: The page positions GoGloby around global expansion and Applied AI engineering rather than its approved staffing and recruiting description.
llm_problems.fix: Reframe the page around GoGloby’s staffing and recruiting services, removing the global-expansion and Applied AI engineering positioning.

llm_problems.title: Benchmark briefing CTA

llm_problems.issue: The page promises engineers will forward-deploy in under four weeks, a timeline not stated in the sources.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the unsupported timeline or replace it with a service-specific timeline supported by the Fact Sheet.

llm_problems.title: Unsupported SOC 2 certification
